name: Scan Alert Locations
objective: Code scanning alerts point at the pinning line, one per package, with a clear first line.
scope: Included: vulnerability-scan.py SARIF rewrite, tests, vulnerability-alerts docs. Excluded: what is scanned.

major_requirements: FR-1 location at the pinning line.
design_decisions: Fingerprint excludes the installed version so an alert persists until fixed.
implementation_decisions: relocate() parses Trivy's message fields; library/ and docker.io/ prefixes recognized as the image itself.
